metadata.description: Rezonia internal Claude Code agent skills for engineering workflows.

plugins.name: jira-workflow
plugins.description: Mandatory Jira workflow gating: ticket discovery/creation with EPIC + Fibonacci story points + sprint, assignee = current MCP user, In Progress on start, In Review on PR open, PR title format that drives auto-Done on merge.

plugins.name: laravel-php-guidelines
plugins.description: Rezonia's PHP + Laravel coding standards: PER coding style, strict typing, early-return control flow, Laravel helpers (Arr/Str/data_get/fluent), Illuminate\Support\Carbon, PHP 8 attributes, translation (__() / @lang()), route tuple notation, enum UPPER_SNAKE_CASE, and full file/class naming conventions.

plugins.name: google-admob-kmp
plugins.description: Implement Google Mobile Ads (AdMob) for Android and iOS in Kotlin Multiplatform (KMP) projects. Covers all ad formats: banner, interstitial, native, app open, rewarded. Handles consent management (UMP/GDPR/ATT), SDK v12+ type renames, iOS Swift bridge pattern, and debugging AdMob in KMP/Compose Multiplatform apps.

plugins.name: filament-guidelines
plugins.description: Rezonia's Filament 5.x coding conventions: simple resources (modal-based), model policy per resource, action notifications via $action->successNotificationTitle()->success() / errorNotificationTitle()->failure() (never Notification facade inside action()), fas-* FontAwesome icons over heroicons, SPA mode wire:navigate compatibility, dark mode semantic colors, Filament Blade components over raw HTML, schema/table class extraction for code quality.

plugins.name: review-fix
plugins.description: Address PR review comments end-to-end: detect the PR, fetch unresolved review threads (bot + human), triage, then per-comment fix/commit/push/reply/resolve. Use after a reviewer (Codex/CodeRabbit/teammate) leaves comments on a pull request. Standalone via gh + git; auto-enhances with claudekit agents when present.
